cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we renew the lease, choose what you want from this dinner: my honest view of living together, or reassurance. Please don't ask for both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Honesty. Just don't say anything that makes me panic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That isn't an instruction I can carry out. You can set the pace, not pre-approve the answer. Shall I begin?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Start by saying we're fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's still an answer, not a pace. Try 'one sentence at a time'. Or we can order dinner and leave the lease unsigned tonight.

reason: Make patient corrective distinctions between pace and guaranteed content drive the choice, preserving uncertainty about A's actual answer.
